summary.content:
Today's selection covers 98 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 66 on Artificial Intelligence and 15 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Trust Is Not What It Seems — And Fraudsters Are Counting on It
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, TechCrunch, Dark Reading, SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 15 articles published in the last 24 hours
